summary: THQ's Avatar: The Last Airbender games adapt the Nickelodeon series across console, handheld, and PC routes with several platform-specific versions.

entries.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
entries.definitive_edition: Main console version on PS2/GameCube/Xbox/Wii, with Windows and handheld versions documented separately

emulation.emulator: PCSX2, Dolphin, xemu, or original hardware depending on chosen platform
emulation.notes: Use owned media and record emulator/platform settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original console hardware or accurate console emulation

primary.why: The main console versions preserve the 2006 original story set between Book 1 and Book 2, while the Windows version uses a different Book 1-based story and different gameplay. There is no normal current official route, so archive capture depends on owned console media or accurate emulation.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PS2/GameCube/Xbox/Wii copy on hardware or accurate emulation. Record platform/region, story route, party/character state, bending upgrades, difficulty, controller, display/emulator settings, and whether the distinct Windows/handheld versions were sampled separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Different story based on Book 1 and different gameplay
secondary.what_to_play: Sample separately if documenting all major versions.
secondary.why: It is not equivalent to the main console version.
The main console version is the archive target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with later Avatar games such as The Burning Earth, Into the Inferno, or Quest for Balance.
